title: The Backstage Prop Disappearance
briefing: During opening night intermission at the historic playhouse, an antique diamond tiara vanished from the dressing room. Three cast members were in the corridor, and one of them is guilty.

suspects.name: Julian Fox
suspects.publicStatement: I was rehearsing monologues in the lower dressing room.

alibiTimeline.label: Called up to the stage wings

suspects.name: Nora Sterling
suspects.publicStatement: I was mending the tenor's torn doublet at the sewing table.

suspects.name: Leo Sterling
suspects.publicStatement: I was up on the catwalk focusing the center spotlight.

clues.title: Lower Dressing Room Sound Recording
clues.description: An acoustic sensor records total silence in Julian's dressing room throughout the intermission.
clues.insight: Contradicts Julian's claim that he was loudly vocalizing monologues.

clues.title: Sewing Thread Bobbin
clues.description: Fresh velvet stitching threads on the sewing table confirm Nora's continuous work on the doublet.
clues.insight: Corroborates Nora's presence at the wardrobe bench during intermission.

clues.title: Lighting Console Log
clues.description: The console logged manual fader movements at 8:24 PM, though a wrench was found below.
clues.insight: Explains why Leo was handling equipment, confirming he remained overhead.

clues.title: Loose Rhinestone Clasp
clues.description: A velvet pouch containing the tiara's missing center gem found hidden behind Julian's mirror.
clues.insight: Connects Julian directly to the stolen jewelry components.

clues.title: Pawn Ticket Receipt
clues.description: A pawn shop deposit slip dated yesterday in Julian's coat pocket.
clues.insight: Demonstrates urgent financial distress motivating theft.

motive: Severe debts led Julian to steal and fence the vintage tiara before leaving town.
method: Slipped out during intermission, snatched the tiara from the vanity, and hid it behind a mirror.
opportunity: Familiarity with backstage corridors enabled avoiding stage managers during scene changes.

deduction.conclusion: Acoustic logs prove Julian was absent from the lower dressing room.
The stolen jewel clasp was recovered from behind Julian's dressing mirror.
The pawn ticket confirms Julian was actively liquidating valuables to clear debts.

timeline.event: Julian leaves his dressing room quietly.
Julian takes the tiara while the dressing room is unattended.
Julian conceals the piece behind his vanity mirror.

hints.text: Check audio logs to determine whether claimed vocal rehearsals actually occurred.
Search near backstage vanities and mirrors for concealed jewelry.
